title: Reconstructing a press calendar
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — SYSTEMS GUIDE | Calendar export
Each press calendar contains two kinds of rows: reserved production time and planner annotations. The overnight export replaces the time rows only. Annotations stay attached to their original calendar.
If you rebuild on a new calendar, copy the annotations separately. A new calendar does not inherit the export destination: the systems team must register it before the overnight job can write there. Only one calendar per press may receive the export.

DOCUMENT 2 — RECOVERY WORKSHEET | Press 8
Calendar P8-M: registered export destination; Tuesday time rows duplicated; annotations readable.
Calendar P8-R: spare calendar; 18 annotations copied from P8-M at 3:00 p.m.; no time rows; not registered for export.
At 4:10 p.m., the late shift added one annotation to P8-M: leave the first Friday slot available for operator training.

DOCUMENT 3 — HANDOVER MESSAGE | 4:30 p.m.
We are making P8-R the working calendar. Tonight’s export will contain corrected Tuesday time rows. Do not copy the old time rows. The systems desk closes at 5:00 p.m.; destination changes received after closing are handled tomorrow.
Keep P8-M visible until tomorrow’s verification, but mark it “reference only” as soon as the systems team confirms the destination change. If that confirmation does not arrive today, leave both calendar names unchanged and tell the morning planner where tonight’s time rows will land.
passageZh:
文件一：系統指南｜行事曆匯出
每台沖床的行事曆有兩類資料列：預留的生產時段，以及排程人員的註記。夜間匯出只會替換時段資料列。註記會留在原本的行事曆上。
若改在新行事曆上重建，請另外複製註記。新行事曆不會自動成為匯出目的地；系統小組必須先登記，夜間作業才能將資料寫入。每台沖床只能有一份行事曆接收匯出。

文件二：復原工作表｜8 號沖床
行事曆 P8-M：已登記為匯出目的地；週二的時段資料列重複；註記仍可讀取。
行事曆 P8-R：備用行事曆；下午三點已從 P8-M 複製 18 則註記；無時段資料列；尚未登記為匯出目的地。
下午 4:10，晚班在 P8-M 新增一則註記：週五第一個時段留給操作員訓練。

文件三：交班訊息｜下午 4:30
我們要改用 P8-R 作為實際排程的行事曆。今晚匯出的資料將包含已修正的週二時段資料列。請不要複製舊的時段資料列。系統服務台下午五點關閉；關閉後收到的匯出目的地變更申請，會在明天處理。
在明天的查核完成前，請保持 P8-M 可見；但系統小組一確認目的地已更改，就要把 P8-M 標為「僅供參考」。如果今天沒有收到確認，請保留兩份行事曆原來的名稱，並告知早班排程人員今晚的時段資料將寫入哪一份。
